newsitem.title: LEBANON: Blast rocks south Lebanon shore.
newsitem.headline: Blast rocks south Lebanon shore.

text.p: An explosion was heard off the southern Lebanon coast at dawn on Monday, a spokesman for the United Nations peacekeepers said.
Timor Goksel told Reuters that guards at the U.N. Interim Forces In Lebanon (UNIFIL) saw an Israeli gunboat firing with machineguns south of the coastal town of Tyre before the blast was heard.
"We can't tell what it was exactly that exploded. Visibility was low but we know it was a very major explosion," he said.
He said it was followed by a smaller blast on the shore.
UNIFIL guards are checking the area to report on the incident, he said.
